title: New Hampshire
dek: Straight from Norway to Boston, then north with the bikes to the White Mountains: Mount Washington, Jackson and the covered bridges, the North Country up to Colebrook, a round of golf at Bretton Woods, and a few days on Cape Cod and in Boston to finish.
map_imgs: The big North Country loop: Jackson, Mount Washington, Errol and Colebrook, about 183 miles.
A loop out of Bethlehem through Franconia, Lincoln and Bear Notch.
map_cap: Two of the loops ridden from Bethlehem.

days.label: Arrive
days.title: Boston
prose: In from Oslo for a night in Boston before heading north.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: North to the White Mountains
prose: The bikes went north by van, and we rode from there into the White Mountains.

photos.cap: An early morning in the North End
The bikes loaded in the van

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Mount Washington and the North Country
prose: Through the Honeymoon Covered Bridge in Jackson and up to the summit of Mount Washington, then north along the Connecticut River.

photos.cap: On the summit of Mount Washington
The Mount Washington Cog Railway at the summit
A covered bridge on the Connecticut River

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Franconia and golf at Bretton Woods
prose: A short ride around Franconia and Sugar Hill, then a round of golf in front of the Mount Washington Hotel.

photos.cap: A Dala horse near Sugar Hill
Omni Mount Washington Hotel, Bretton Woods
Golf at the Mount Washington Resort

days.label: Day 4
days.title: South to Tilton and back by the covered bridges
prose: Breakfast at the Tilt’n Diner, then back north by way of the Bath Covered Bridge.

photos.cap: The Cadillac breakfast at the Tilt’n Diner

days.label: After the ride
days.title: Cape Cod and Boston
prose: Golf at Eastward Ho! in Chatham on Cape Cod, then back to Boston.

photos.cap: Dinner with friends on Cape Cod
The arch at Rowes Wharf, Boston
